gate: Notice the person who reads the small print before signing, who catches the typo three pages in, who insists on the actual numbers when everyone else is rounding. That is this code as a gate, the pull toward the small specifics that make a claim land or fall apart. Detail is not pedantry here. It is the practical floor of communication, the part that decides whether a plan can survive contact with reality. A person carrying this gate feels the missing piece as a small wrongness in the body, a friction that will not let the sentence go until the figure is right. The misread is to call this fussy, or to imagine the work could be done without it. The world runs on the people who check. What gets called nitpicking is the same instinct that keeps a bridge standing and a contract honest.
centre_field: Speech is the body's centre here, the place where everything inside finally crosses over into the world as voice or act. The throat does not generate; it manifests. Whatever moves up from the other centres has to pass through this gate to become real for anyone else. That placement is the teaching. The code for detail is not stored as a private appreciation of small things. It is wired to come out, as language, as the careful sentence, as the corrected figure. The body insists on speaking the detail, not just noticing it. To hold the precision silent is to leave the circuit half-finished. The throat puts the small fact into the room, where it can be checked, used, argued with, built on. The detail is meant to be heard, in plain words, in front of other people.
channel: Detail without a pattern is only clutter. This code reaches toward the gate of opinion, the mental work that takes scattered observations and shapes them into a logical view. The two together form a channel of acceptance, the spine of logical thought in the body-map. The reach is what makes the detail useful. Facts on their own do not teach; they accumulate. What the partner gate brings is the pattern, the seeing-of-the-shape, the move from a hundred small noticings into a claim that can be tested. This code carries the precision and the voice. The other side carries the read. Without the pattern, the detail becomes a stream of correctness with no place to land. Joined, the two make a teaching that holds. The code is built to need the mind that organises what it sees.
